# Smart KTeam

> Smart KTeam is a digital marketing agency based in Seattle, WA, helping small businesses across the US & Canada get found online through website design, local SEO, Google Ads, booking and payment systems, and insurance claims management for US massage therapists.

## Key facts

- Website: https://smartkteam.com
- Based in: Seattle, WA, United States
- Founded: 2023
- Area served: United States and Canada
- Insurance Claims for Massage Therapists: United States only
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM (Pacific Time)
- Languages: English, Spanish, Chinese
- Contact: email smart.kteam.us@gmail.com (no phone number is published), or the contact form at https://smartkteam.com/#contact
- Pricing: published on each service page; starting prices are listed under Services and full package details are in llms-full.txt
- Profiles: [Google Business Profile](https://maps.app.goo.gl/i5YFFXBN7QwyV4dU6), [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/smartkteam), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/smartkteam/)

## Services

- [Website Design & Development](https://smartkteam.com/website-design): Fast, mobile-first websites that turn visitors into paying customers. Smart KTeam builds SEO-ready sites for small businesses in the US & Canada. Pricing: packages from $1,190.
- [Local SEO & Search Ranking](https://smartkteam.com/seo): Rank higher on Google and get found by ready-to-buy customers. Local SEO, technical fixes and content strategy for small businesses. From $399. Pricing: packages from $399/mo.
- [Booking & Payment Systems](https://smartkteam.com/booking-payment): Let customers book and pay 24/7. Smart KTeam sets up online booking and secure payments for salons, spas and service businesses in the US & Canada. Pricing: packages from $199.
- [Google Ads Management](https://smartkteam.com/google-ads): Stop wasting ad budget. Smart KTeam runs data-driven Google Ads campaigns that bring qualified leads from day one. Serving the US & Canada. Pricing: packages from $299/mo.
- [Insurance Claims for Massage Therapists](https://smartkteam.com/insurance-claims): ClinicFlow handles insurance credentialing and claims end to end for massage therapy practices across the US. You focus on patients, we do the paperwork. Pricing: from $10 per claim.
